subject: general
question: A famous hill station 'Ranikhet' is located on which mountain?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Himalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ranikhet** is a famous hill station located in the **state of Uttarakhand, India**, which lies in the **Himalayan mountain range**.
 
• The name Ranikhet translates to "**Queen's Meadow**" and is associated with a legend about a queen who fell in love with its natural beauty.
 
• Ranikhet is renowned for its **scenic landscapes, pleasant climate, and lush greenery**, making it a popular destination for tourists.
 
• The hill station is situated at an altitude of about **1,869 meters (6,131 feet)** above sea level.
 
• It offers stunning views of the **Himalayan peaks**, including **Nanda Devi**, the second-highest mountain in India.
 
• Ranikhet is also known for its **British-era cantonment area** and is home to the **Kumaon Regiment** of the Indian Army.
 
• The region is rich in **biodiversity**, with forests of pine, oak, and deodar trees, along with a variety of wildlife.
 
• Popular attractions include the **Jhula Devi Temple, Chaubatia Orchards**, and the **Golf Course**, which is one of the highest golf courses in Asia.
 
• Ranikhet serves as a base for trekking and exploring nearby areas in the **Kumaon Himalayas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eastern Ghats**__

 __
 
• The **Eastern Ghats** are a discontinuous range of mountains along the **eastern coast of India**.
 
• They run through states like **Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka**.
 
• Unlike the Himalayas, the Eastern Ghats have a much lower altitude and are known for their **ancient geological formations**.
 
• Famous hills in this range include the **Nallamala Hills** and the **Mahendragiri Hills**.
 
 
 
• **Western Ghats**__
 __
 
• The **Western Ghats**, also known as the **Sahyadri Hills**, are a mountain range that runs parallel to the **western coast of India**.
 
• They are a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and are known for their **rich biodiversity**.
 
• The Western Ghats are home to popular hill stations like **Munnar, Ooty, and Lonavala**.
 
 
 
• **Aravali**__
 
 
• The **Aravali Range** is one of the **oldest mountain ranges in the world**, spanning across **Rajasthan, Haryana, and Delhi**.
 
• It is characterized by its **eroded hills** and is an important source of **minerals** in India.
 
• Famous landmarks include **Mount Abu**, the highest peak in the range, which is also a popular hill station.
